neighbours.label: the token right after a famous cartoon or animated character ('characters like Woody,', 'Mickey Mouse and', 'a bar with Homer')
fire: Kids adore cartoon friends like Buzz, Woody, and Rex.
At Disney World you can hug Donald Duck and other favorites.
My nephew collects toys of Elsa, Olaf, and Anna.
In the old shorts, Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck argue a lot.
Her lunchbox shows Mickey, Goofy, and Pluto on a boat.
Young fans dress up as Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey.
The park parade features Minnie Mouse and dozens of others.
Everyone knows Bart, Lisa, and Maggie from television.
quiet: Kids adore garden foods like beans, carrots, and peas.
At the county fair you can pet goats and other livestock.
My nephew collects stamps from Peru, Chile, and Brazil.
In the old days, farmers and millers argued a lot.
Her lunchbox holds bread, cheese, and fruit in a bag.
Young cooks work with flour, butter, and sugar.
The town parade features fire trucks and dozens of bands.
Everyone knows Paris, Rome, and Madrid from school.

notes: Card: ',' x5, ' and' x4, ' of' x2, ' at', 'When', 'pa', ' with'. Probe: ',' after Woody 0.898; ' and' after Mickey Mouse 0.514; ' at' before a bar 0.228 (and 0.130 with friends); ' and' after Aquasar 0.121; vegetables and horses 0.011. Near misses list other things in similar frames. The supercomputer and 'When' peaks are not covered.
